name: @mcugl/frontpack-buildtool
description: Scaffold, run and package third-party frontends for MCUGL Launcher (.mcuglf).

scripts.test: node tests/create.test.mjs && node tests/i18n.test.mjs && node tests/ui.test.mjs && node tests/wizard.test.mjs
